subject: gk
question: Which of the following statement is NOT correct regarding the liver?

options.text: It is situated in the upper part of the abdomen on the left side.
It secretes bile juice that is stored in a sac called the gall bladder.
It is the largest gland in the body.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is situated in the upper part of the abdomen on the left side.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The liver is situated in the upper part of the abdomen on the right side, not the left side. Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.**
 
• The liver secretes bile juice that is stored in the **gallbladder and helps in the digestion of fats. **This is mentioned in** statement 2, which is correct.**
 
• The liver is the largest gland in the body and performs several vital functions such as detoxification, protein synthesis, and storage of vitamins and minerals. This is mentioned in statement 3, which is correct.
 
• The liver is reddish-brown in color due to the presence of blood vessels and hepatocytes (liver cells). This is mentioned in statement 4, which is correct.
 
• There is no option 5 mentioned in the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The liver weighs around 1.5 kg in adults and is divided into four lobes.
 
• The liver receives blood from the hepatic artery and the portal vein, which carries nutrients from the intestines.
 
• The liver plays a crucial role in maintaining the body's metabolic balance by regulating glucose, cholesterol, and lipid levels.
 
• Liver diseases such as hepatitis, cirrhosis, and liver cancer can affect the liver's structure and function and can be life-threatening if left untreated.
